author: piztanza
description: Buyer 'Get notified' capture (F-015): inline email field in the buyer strip → rate-limited POST /api/notify → contact added to the account's single Resend Audience (RESEND_AUDIENCE_ID if set, else safe auto-discovery requiring exactly one audience; zero/multiple → alert-email fallback so nothing is lost), tagged source=buyer_launch for the user's existing 'Buyers' segment; duplicates treated as success; bilingual inline success/error states.
acceptance_criteria: 'Get notified' expands an inline email field in the strip (no navigation); reduced-motion expands instantly; bilingual placeholder/labels/success/error copy in the approved tone
POST /api/notify: 10/h/IP rate limit, invalid email → 400 with bilingual inline error, honeypot → silent fake success
Contact lands in the Resend audience tagged source=buyer_launch (visible under the user's 'Buyers' segment); duplicate email → success UX

Auto-discovery uses RESEND_AUDIENCE_ID when set; otherwise exactly-one-audience lookup with module-scope caching; zero or multiple audiences → logged error + alert email fallback to WAITLIST_ALERT_TO with the buyer address
RESEND_AUDIENCE_ID documented as optional in .env.example; README notes the property key used for the segment filter
Suite green incl. validation, honeypot, discovery single/zero/multiple, and already-exists tests
